content: Ship forge §7 SOLVER-backed vacuity checks (steps 2-3) in forge/src/vacuity_solver.rs (new), wired into check::check_file after #6 triage / before L3 (inside the cache-miss branch so the verdict is cached). Two harnesses reuse thermite_lower::lower's verbatim requires/ensures: tautology = proof fn taut_check(<params>, result: <RET>) requires <req>; ensures <ens>; { } (verus PROVES iff ens holds for an arbitrary result); vacuity = proof fn vac_check(<params>) requires <req>; { assert(false); } (PROVES iff req unsat). interpret_summary: PROVED->detected, FAILED->clean, VIR/absent/unparseable->ForgeError (R-CODE-4). manifest::Certificate::rejected_vacuity sets the matching contract_quality bool true (no schema change). Vacuity checked before tautology (unsat req would spuriously prove tautology too). Oracle: conformance/solver-vacuity/cases.json. Gauntlet green: workspace 35 test-bins 0 failed, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check. Commit footer (#13); do NOT close (critic re-audits).
